color.note: Neon Dusk: an indigo night, a mustard sun that drives every action, violet hills for the Coach and a dusty rose for the Buddy. Flat, mid-century colour. There is no red in any learner-facing state.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background of every tab and full-screen flow. Lavender paper by day, indigo night by night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised cards and sheets on canvas: fix cards, the strength card, Home's secondary card, bottom sheets, settings groups.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: audio clip wells, secondary buttons, meter tracks, the 'Once more' result. Neutral by day so it never blends with hills-soft.

tokens.name: material-bar
tokens.usage: Translucent chrome that content scrolls under: the 3-tab bar and sticky headers. Add a 20px backdrop blur on Android 12+; below that the fill alone is the material.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a modal bottom sheet. Never behind non-blocking hint cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and filled icons on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (≥ 13:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, timestamps, inactive tab labels, the learner's own waveform. On canvas, surface and surface-sunken (≥ 6.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder glyphs only. Passes 4.5:1 on canvas and surface; never meaningful text on surface-sunken at night (≈ 4.1:1).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and inside cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: unselected answer chips, the age checkbox, outline tiles, toggle off. ≥ 3.3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The mustard sun, the one action colour: the Talk button, the single primary button per screen, the your-turn mic ring, streak suns, toggles on. Text and glyphs on it are always on-sun. By day it needs sun-edge to stand off the page.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on a sun fill (9.5:1).

tokens.name: sun-edge
tokens.usage: 1.5px inner outline on sun-filled controls. By day it gives the button a visible edge against lavender paper (≥ 3:1); at night it equals sun, because the fill already glows (9.9:1).

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Mustard as text: quiet links ('Change', 'Start a new chat'), the highlighted word in 'You said'. On canvas, surface and sun-soft (≥ 6:1).

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Mustard tint behind the word you said, selected answer chips and the today marker. Text on it is ink or sun-ink.

tokens.name: hills
tokens.usage: The Coach's violet hills: the model-voice waveform and play disc, the Coach mark, skill meter fills, the listen-back bars. Text on it is on-hills.

tokens.name: on-hills
tokens.usage: Glyphs and text on a hills fill (8.3:1 by day, 8.4:1 at night).

tokens.name: hills-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as text: 'Your coach' eyebrows, upgraded words in 'Say it better', the Bangla toggle. On canvas, surface and hills-soft (≥ 6:1).

tokens.name: hills-soft
tokens.usage: Violet tint behind the strength card, upgraded words and the mouth-tip row.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: The Buddy's dusty rose: the horizon glow and the Buddy mark. Softened from neon on purpose; never push it back to full neon. Text on it is on-rose.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Glyphs on a rose fill (6.5:1).

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose as text: the streak count and Buddy-story hooks. On canvas, surface and rose-soft (≥ 5.5:1).

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet rose fill behind the streak pill.

tokens.name: buddy
tokens.usage: Alias for anything that belongs to the Buddy (the mark, story hooks). Points at rose.

tokens.name: coach
tokens.usage: Alias for anything that belongs to the Coach (debrief, drills, progress insights). Points at hills. If Phase 0 picks one character with two modes, repoint this and nothing else changes.

tokens.name: clip-you
tokens.usage: Waveform bars of the learner's own clip. Neutral on purpose: your voice is never coloured as good or bad.

tokens.name: clip-model
tokens.usage: Waveform bars and play disc of the model voice.

tokens.name: nailed
tokens.usage: The 'Nailed it' result, Improving tags, '11 → 4' improvement chips. Always with the check icon and the word. On canvas, surface and nailed-soft (≥ 4.9:1).

tokens.name: nailed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the 'Nailed it' pill and the Fixed-section celebration.

tokens.name: closer
tokens.usage: The 'Closer' result. It sits near the mustard sun in hue, so it must always carry the up-right arrow and the word. On canvas, surface and closer-soft (≥ 5:1).

tokens.name: closer-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the 'Closer' pill.

tokens.name: once-more
tokens.usage: The 'Let's try once more' result: neutral, never red. Pairs with surface-sunken.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Destructive actions in Me → Privacy only ('Delete everything', 'Delete recording'). Never in conversation, debrief, drills or progress.

tokens.name: mouth-flesh
tokens.usage: Lips, gums, palate and a still tongue in the mouth-position diagrams. The inside of the mouth stays `surface`.

tokens.name: mouth-move
tokens.usage: The one part that moves in a mouth-position diagram (lip or tongue), edged in `hills-ink`. Brighter than `mouth-flesh` in both themes so the eye goes there first.

tokens.name: mouth-tooth
tokens.usage: Teeth in the mouth-position diagrams, outlined in `ink`. Light in both themes, because teeth are.

tokens.name: provider-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the 'Continue with Google' button only. Google's own light and dark button values, so the button meets Google's sign-in branding rules; never use it for anything else.

tokens.name: provider-line
tokens.usage: 1px outline of the 'Continue with Google' button (Google's values).

tokens.name: provider-ink
tokens.usage: Label on the 'Continue with Google' button (Google's values).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus: a 2px solid ring 3px outside the control. ≥ 7.6:1 on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: scene-sky-high
tokens.usage: Top of the night sky and the voice-only background. Scene colours do not change with theme: the scene is always dusk.

tokens.name: scene-sky-mid
tokens.usage: The violet middle of the sky, between indigo and the rose horizon. The sky is always three flat-blended steps, never a two-colour jump.

tokens.name: scene-sky-low
tokens.usage: The dusty-rose horizon glow.

tokens.name: scene-sun
tokens.usage: The setting sun disc, its soft glow (আভা) and the companion's rim light. The same mustard as sun, so the Talk button is the sun.

tokens.name: scene-star
tokens.usage: Star dust and the two twinkling bright stars.

tokens.name: scene-hill-far
tokens.usage: Far violet ridge.

tokens.name: scene-hill-near
tokens.usage: Near hill the learner and companion sit on; also the floor under the mic ring.

tokens.name: scene-plate
tokens.usage: Caption and hint plates over the scene. Holds on-scene text at ≥ 7.3:1 even over the sun.

tokens.name: on-scene
tokens.usage: Buddy captions, Pause and End labels over the scene or on scene-plate.

tokens.name: on-scene-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text over the scene on scene-plate (≥ 5.4:1): hint labels, 'Your Buddy is thinking…'.

type.note: Anek Bangla sets both scripts: one family drawn for Bangla and English together, so switching language never changes the voice. Track tighter only on English display sizes; never track Bangla.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Once-in-a-while moments only: the Day 1 vs Day N reveal, the drills summary headline, big counts.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Tab titles at the top of Progress and Me. Home has none: the Talk button is its title.

styles.name: title-1
styles.sample: What do you need English for most?
styles.usage: Onboarding questions, the Coach's strength sentence, state-panel headlines.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Fix-card titles, sheet titles, section heads inside Progress.

styles.name: buddy-line
styles.sample: Oh nice, what was the bug doing?
styles.usage: Live caption of the Buddy's line on scene-plate. Never below 18px (US-9.3); scales with system font size.

styles.name: sentence
styles.sample: Yesterday I fixed a bug in the payment service.
styles.usage: Quoted learner sentences and model sentences in fix cards and 'Say it better' drills.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, card titles in lists, the emphasised line of a paragraph.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bolo listens only while you practise.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Sentences under 12 words.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Top teeth touch your lower lip for v.
styles.usage: Mouth tips, one-line explanations under a title, hint starters.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Scenario label under Talk, metadata rows, skill names.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Some feedback was skipped because of background noise.
styles.usage: Notes, timestamps, legal lines in consent. Never for an instruction the learner must follow.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Eyebrows over clips ('You said', 'Try'), tab labels, timeline ticks. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: label-talk
styles.usage: The word inside the Talk button only.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, chips, segmented options. Verb first, sentence case.

styles.name: bangla-helper
styles.usage: One-line Bangla helper under English on onboarding and error screens; ink-secondary. Taller leading for matras and conjuncts.

styles.name: bangla-body
styles.sample: উপরের দাঁত নিচের ঠোঁটে ছুঁইয়ে v বলুন।
styles.usage: A tip shown in Bangla after tapping 'বাংলায়' (DBF-7).

spacing.note: A 4dp grid. px here means dp on Android.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills, waveform bar gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control, between chips in a row, progress dots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stacked text inside a card (title → tip), list-row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, between related groups in a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side margins at 360dp and card padding. The one margin of the app.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards, sheet padding, above a primary button.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections; top of a sheet to its title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Breathing room around the Talk button and the mic ring.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top inset of tab titles below the status bar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on onboarding and the Day 1 vs Day N reveal.

radius.note: Continuous (squircle) corners wherever the platform allows; capsules for anything you press.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Word highlights inside sentences, timeline ticks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tiles inside cards: tip row, waveform well.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Minimal-pair tiles, Home's secondary card, hint plates.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: fix, strength, voice compare, settings groups; caption plate.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners and full-height debrief cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, result pills, toggles, the Talk disc, the mic ring.

shadow.note: Depth is quiet. By day a soft violet-tinted shadow; at night a hairline light edge, because shadows vanish on indigo.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The Talk button's warm sun glow. Only the Talk button and the your-turn mic ring glow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the hint card rising over content.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that make Bolo thumb-first (R11) and AX-2 compliant.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control (AX-2). Small visuals get invisible padding up to this.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons; chips are 48.

tokens.name: talk-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the Talk disc (AX-2 asks ≥ 96).

tokens.name: mic-ring
tokens.usage: Diameter of the conversation mic ring, including its time arc.

tokens.name: play-disc
tokens.usage: Play button inside an audio clip (48 hit area).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size (Material Symbols Rounded, opsz 24).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, plus the gesture inset.

tokens.name: screen-min
tokens.usage: Design width; check every screen at 412 too.
